main_text.l: fodiamus, vt ante hæc semefa piorum monumenta supplices procumbamus, vt diuinam ab illis virtutem, siue sanatio-num, siue sanctificationis expectemus, vt æque suspiciamus Francisci cucullum, Annę pectinem, caligam Iosephi, Thomæ calceum (quod Erasmus queritur) ac ipsum Dei filium, vix vllo nobis piaculo luendùm videri solet: Neque nobis, aut homines inter Deos, aut bestias inter diuos referre placebit vnquam; Placuit certè Cardinali illi, cuius in hortis, videre est hoc, cani suæ (vah quàm nimiùm dilectæ) Epitaphium:

page.notes: Marginal text on the left page edge is show-through and not transcribed. Words such as "semefa" and "Annę" are as printed; "semefa" may be "semesa" or similar and is uncertain.
